events.title: International Bancshares: Q4 Earnings Snapshot
events.body: The Laredo, Texas-based bank said it had earnings of $1.71 per share. The financial holding company posted revenue of $270.1 million in the period. Its revenue net of interest expense was $217.7 million, which topped Street forecasts.
